title: Recipe Nutrition Estimator
description: Paste ingredient lines, match them against a nutrition database, get macros per serving.
howto: Paste one ingredient per line, e.g. "200g chicken breast" or "2 tbsp olive oil".
Supported units: g, kg, oz, lb. Lines without an amount are assumed to be 100 g and flagged.
Enter the number of servings the recipe makes.
Click Estimate to see matched ingredients, totals, and per-serving macros.

faqs.a: Grams (g), kilograms (kg), ounces (oz), and pounds (lb/lbs). A line like '2 cups flour' has no convertible unit and will be listed as unmatched.
Each line is matched against the 42-food database by name. Unmatched lines are listed so you can fix the wording.
It is an estimate from typical per-100g values. Unmatched ingredients are excluded from the totals, which the report shows.
